title: Wudu step by step
intro: Wudu is the washing we do before Salah.

learn.html: Before Salah we make wudu (abdest). We wash parts of our body with clean water, always starting with the right side.

items.label: 6. Wash the right arm, then the left, past the elbow, 3 times
7. Masah – wipe the head with wet hands
10. Wash the right foot, then the left, up to the ankle

learn.title: 🚱 Save water
learn.html: Use just enough water for wudu, and turn the tap off when you finish.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Wudu is broken by going to the toilet, passing wind, deep sleep and bleeding. Then we make wudu again before we pray.

practice.title: Wudu in order
practice.prompt: Tap the steps of wudu in the right order.

practice.title: What breaks wudu?
practice.prompt: Tap everything that breaks wudu, then tap Check.

questions.q: What do we say when we start wudu?
Which side do we wash first?
How many times do we wash the face?

options: Wiping the head with wet hands

questions.q: What is the last step of wudu?
options: Washing the feet, then the Shahadah
